audience: fitness studio owners and administrators who manage classes, passes and sales in Fitssey

useCases.title: Review upcoming class capacity
useCases.text: Read a date-bounded schedule, inspect remaining class capacity and check the sessions included in online-bookable courses.

useCases.title: Compare pass offerings
useCases.text: Review pass prices and session allowances, then inspect individual offerings and the contract catalog.

useCases.title: Check studio product stock
useCases.text: Review a page of products and inspect stock, SKU and price for individual items when checking supplies.

useCases.title: Inspect recorded sales
useCases.text: Read sales for a date range one page at a time, checking items, amounts and payment methods without treating one page as total revenue.

useCases.title: Review active passes and attendance
useCases.text: Inspect active-pass validity and remaining allowances by client ID, then review a page of recorded class visits. Customer names, contact details and private notes are omitted.
